links.outcome: LLM accuracy of recommendations and rationales against WHO SSI prevention guidelines (5-point Likert)
links.effect: Recommendation accuracy mean 4.03 (SD 1.09); rationale accuracy 3.74 (SD 0.91) and comprehensiveness 3.85 (SD 0.83), moderate level; harm scores ≥4.
links.quote: In contrast, consistency (mean 3.94, SD 0.72), clarity (mean 3.94, SD 0.89), comprehensiveness (mean 3.85, SD 0.83), and accuracy (mean 3.74, SD 0.91) performed at a moderate level.

links.outcome: Consistency of chatbot responses across 3 repeated runs of the same queries
links.effect: Recommendation consistency mean 4.07 (SD 0.88); rationale consistency 3.94 (SD 0.72), moderate; authors call for enhancing chatbot stability.
links.quote: Nonetheless, a critical issue is the necessity of enhancing the stability of chatbots, as inaccurate responses can lead to severe consequences for SSI.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance and accuracy of several LLM chatbots (ChatGPT-4o, OpenAI-o1, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro) in answering queries based on WHO surgical site infection guidelines, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
